scope: Canonical structural Gemma execution IR compiled from a frozen architecture manifest; primitive equations are declared, but bit-exact numerical qualification requires a separate execution-profile certificate.

ADD.rounding: execution-profile addition and cast semantics required

ARGMAX.equation: output[b] is the lowest token index whose value equals max_token input[b,0,token]

CAUSAL_MASK.equation: output[b,1,q,k] = 0 when k <= q and, if sliding_window is set, k > q - sliding_window; otherwise output is the minimum finite output_dtype value

GELU_TANH.rounding: execution-profile constants, operation order, transcendental, and casts required

LINEAR.rounding: execution-profile multiply-accumulate and reduction order required

MATMUL_AV.rounding: execution-profile multiply-accumulate and reduction order required

MATMUL_QK.rounding: execution-profile multiply-accumulate and reduction order required

MUL.rounding: execution-profile multiplication and cast semantics required

RMS_NORM.equation: output = cast(input * rsqrt(mean(float32(input)^2, last_axis) + epsilon) * (1 + float32(weight)), input_dtype)
RMS_NORM.rounding: execution-profile reduction, rsqrt, multiplication, and cast semantics required

ROTARY_APPLY_PAIR.equation: query_out = query * cosine + rotate_half(query) * sine; key_out = key * cosine + rotate_half(key) * sine

ROTARY_TABLE.equation: angles[b,s,d] = float32(position_ids[b,s]) * inverse_frequency[d]; cosine and sine are duplicated across head_dimension then cast to output_dtype
ROTARY_TABLE.rounding: execution-profile transcendental and cast semantics required

SOFTCAP.rounding: execution-profile transcendental and operation order required

SOFTMAX.equation: output[i] = cast(exp(float32(input[i]) - max(float32(input))) / sum(exp(float32(input) - max(float32(input)))), output_dtype)
SOFTMAX.rounding: execution-profile maximum, exponential, reduction order, division, and cast semantics required
